HomePage.title: منصة شهادات ESTQB إثيوبيا
HomePage.description: The Ethiopian Software Testing Qualifications Board (ESTQB) is the official national board dedicated to advancing software quality. We provide internationally recognized certifications that validate your QA expertise, standardize industry practices, and connect Ethiopian talent to global opportunities.
HomePage.statCertifiedDesc: قيادة برمجيات عالية الجودة في إثيوبيا
HomePage.whyChooseSub: In a rapidly evolving tech landscape, standing out is essential. ESTQB certifications are the gold standard in software testing, offering unparalleled benefits for your professional growth.
HomePage.val1Desc: Achieving an ESTQB certification means your credentials are valid and respected by top-tier technology companies and employers in over 130 countries worldwide. It serves as an international passport for your QA career.
HomePage.val2Desc: Master structured testing techniques, best practices, and agile methodologies based on industry-leading global curricula. Our syllabi ensure you speak the same technical language as testers anywhere in the world.
HomePage.val3Desc: Connect with a rapidly growing network of qualified QA professionals in Ethiopia. Gain access to exclusive industry events, continuous learning resources, and career advancement opportunities.
HomePage.certSub: ابدأ رحلتك اليوم مع مناهج الاختبار المعترف بها عالمياً.
HomePage.journeySub: أربع خطوات بسيطة للحصول على اعتماد ضمان الجودة العالمي الخاص بك.
HomePage.step1Desc: أنشئ ملف تعريف المرشح الخاص بك للبدء في تتبع امتحاناتك.
HomePage.step2Desc: قم بتنزيل مواد المنهج الرسمي واحضر جلسات التدريب.
HomePage.step3Desc: حدد موعداً واجتاز امتحانك الصارم عبر الإنترنت أو في الموقع.
HomePage.step4Desc: احصل على شهادتك القابلة للتحقق عالمياً وقم بترقية حياتك المهنية.
HomePage.newsSub: ابق على اطلاع بإعلانات ضمان الجودة والنصائح واتجاهات الصناعة.
HomePage.ctaDesc: انضم إلى الآلاف من متخصصي اختبار البرمجيات المعتمدين وافتح فرص عمل جديدة عالمياً.
HomePage.whoWeAreSub: Elevating the standards of software engineering across Ethiopia.
HomePage.whoWeAreDesc1: As a member of the International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB), we are responsible for ensuring that software testing professionals in Ethiopia have access to the highest quality, standardized, and globally recognized certification schemes. Our mission is to promote the value of software testing as a critical profession.
HomePage.whoWeAreDesc2: Whether you are a university student just starting your QA journey, or a seasoned professional looking to validate your expertise, ESTQB provides the resources, syllabi, and examinations necessary to achieve your career goals.

Footer.description: هيئة إصدار الشهادات الرسمية لاختبار البرمجيات في إثيوبيا. الارتقاء بمعايير ضمان الجودة من خلال الشهادات المعترف بها عالميًا.
